# D4 catalogue reference inventory

Generated by `node scripts/catalogue/audit-clean-runtime.mjs`. Counts are individual lexical occurrences classified by **catalogue dependency**, not file counts. The six requested categories cover 7498 occurrences; 535 additional generic tokens/rejection guards are explicitly listed separately, never silently discarded. This report excludes itself to avoid recursive growth. Historical D1/D2/D3 files are preserved.

`ACTIVE_CANONICAL_RUNTIME = 0` means no required legacy catalogue data source/identity/ranking/alias. It does not mean zero literal strings in the combined production bundle. Active validators intentionally reject the old prefix; generic `value` variables and `starts` prose are not football data. Generated bundle counts overlap their source code by design.

Canonical tests run without rosters.js, without public.teams/players, and after dropping both empty alias tables. The server provider resolver uses only team_provider_ids/player_provider_ids. TFF membership input/attribution is absent from canonical operation. Legacy production branches are retained, not purged by deleting evidence.
